defects.title: Qualification evidence does not cover the load-bearing value-wiring path
defects.detail: The adversarial_checks claim in GATE.json ('32 single-edit mutants of the decision path; every mutant must be killed') is not true for the path that selects inputs from the real sources and feeds them to the certificate. Five unsound single-edit mutants survive the frozen suite: using D0.lo instead of D0.hi, M5 from order 4, swapping L1 and U0, using x1 in place of e0 in G, and using e0 in place of a in the transport. So does exec_science_or. Any of these would make the exactly-once execution emit a wrong result, and some would emit an unsound CERTIFIED. The committed code is correct by my line-by-line inspection, but the qualification evidence would not have detected such an error.
defects.repair: Add (i) a test asserting the exact values extract_inputs returns from synthetic sources with a distinct value per field (D0 lo != hi, L0/L1/U0/U1 distinct, M2..M5 distinct per n and m), and (ii) an end-to-end synthetic execute test: a synthetic repo with PROVENANCE-bound sources, a FREEZE.json with FREEZE_HASH, the exact expected G/T/B/outcome per m, and science and assembly flags in both directions. Add the surviving mutants to the harness, then re-run the harness.
